goals.subject: math
goals.title: 按物点数与按数取物
goals.scope: 逐一对应物体与数词；按确认数域逐步从10、20扩至100、10000；万以内为学段末要求，不由旧千以内证据自动继承

goals.criterionEn: Count without omissions or repeats and report the total; select the requested number of objects.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 理解零
goals.scope: 已确认数域内的空集合与数0

goals.criterionEn: Use 0 for an empty set and distinguish zero from an unanswered question.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 数的分与合
goals.scope: 10以内整体与两部分关系，允许0

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Find the missing part and recombine both parts to recover the whole.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 理解十进位值
goals.scope: 依确认范围识别一、十、百、千及占位0；万以内为学段末要求，不由旧千以内证据自动继承
goals.criterion: 实物束/计数器与数位对应；解释如305为何十位是0

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Match bundles or an abacus to place values; explain the zero tens digit in 305.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 读数
goals.scope: 10/20/100/10000以内；含中间0的范围单独记录；万以内为学段末要求，不由旧千以内证据自动继承
goals.criterion: 从数码正确读出数值；文字答案只证明书面读法

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Read the numeric value correctly; a written response establishes only the written number name.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 写数
goals.scope: 确认数域内，由数词或位值表示写数；万以内为学段末要求，不由旧千以内证据自动继承
goals.criterion: 写对各数位和占位0；实际听写另需音频来源

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Write correct digits and placeholder zeros; dictation also requires an actual audio source.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 比较数的大小
goals.scope: 确认数域内，两数或等量物体；范围不跨证据继承；万以内为学段末要求，不由旧千以内证据自动继承
goals.criterion: 指出关系，正确用符号；多位数能按最高不同数位说明

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Identify the relation and use its symbol; explain multi-digit comparisons using the highest differing place.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 区分数量与顺序
goals.scope: 具体队列，明确从哪端起
goals.criterion: 分别回答总数与指定序位，能指出起点改变后序位变化

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Give the total and the ordinal position; explain how a different starting end changes the position.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 确定相邻数与相邻整十数
goals.scope: 100以内；相邻整数与整十边界分开检验

goals.criterionEn: Identify preceding and following integers; separately identify the bounding multiples of ten.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 建立加法数量关系
goals.scope: 合并或增加情境，数域由当前范围确定
goals.criterion: 指出两部分与总量，列式并说明为何相加

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Identify the two parts and total, write an equation, and explain why addition applies.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 建立减法数量关系
goals.scope: 去掉、求剩余或求差；题目结构分别覆盖

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Identify known and unknown quantities, write an equation, and explain why subtraction applies.

goals.title: 正确计算加法
goals.scope: 10/20/100/1000内，是否进位、是否连续进位独立记录

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Produce the correct sum and a checkable process for the requested method; choosing a result alone is insufficient.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 正确计算减法
goals.scope: 10/20/100/1000内，退位/连续退位/跨0分别覆盖
goals.criterion: 结果正确并保留过程；方法要求与数域必须与本次证据一致

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Keep the correct result and process; the demonstrated method and number range must match the credited scope.

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Explain or write the first operation and obtain the correct final result.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 检验计算结果
goals.scope: 已确认加减或乘除范围；逆运算、重算与估算不得相互冒充

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 理解平均分与包含除
goals.scope: 确认总量与等分/分组情境；与具体教材关联待核对
goals.criterion: 区分分几份与每份几个，写除法式并说明量的意义

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Distinguish number of groups from amount per group and explain the quantities in the division equation.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 用乘法事实计算除法

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计

goals.criterionEn: Find the quotient and check it using multiplication.

goals.title: 理解并计算有余数除法
goals.scope: 确认的表内范围及余数情境；校内范围未确认不默认启用

goals.criterionEn: Record leftover objects after equal grouping; the remainder is smaller than the divisor and units agree.

goals.subject: math
goals.title: 解决简单数量问题

sourceLocators.section: 四、课程内容／相应学段要求；操作判据为本方案设计
